manifest.author: Howard Hoy
manifest.description: Manages an Obsidian vault through 28 actions — 30-60-90 plans, OKRs, Kanban boards, dashboards, briefs, wiki ingestion, and health checks.
manifest.name: @howardh/vaultmind_agent

action.description: add_person=create a new person's 30-60-90 folder, roster=list all people, check_in=status for one person, retire=archive a person, assign=add a priority task, priorities=show priority board, metrics=person metrics, report=generate HTML dashboard, dashboard=quick text summary, compile=rebuild wiki from raw sources, ingest=add content to vault, health=wiki lint check, query=search wiki, review=weekly review, plan=personal 30-60-90 status, brief=generate morning digest, watch=add/list monitored URLs, job_status=show all scheduled jobs, run_job=manually trigger a job, setup=configure scheduled jobs, pause=pause or resume a job, bootstrap=create vault structure + install Obsidian plugins automatically, training=read a person's learning objectives and design a training quest, build_quest=render training quest HTML from checkpoint JSON, paste=quick-ingest raw text into 01-raw, log=show or add to activity log, okr=track objectives and key results per person, kanban=generate Kanban board from priorities

checkpoints.description: JSON array of checkpoint objects for build_quest action

content.description: Raw text content for paste action

enabled.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) a job in setup

job.description: Job name for run_job/pause/setup actions: morning_brief, content_watch, auto_review, wiki_health, phase_alert, digest

key_result.description: Key result text for okr action

url.description: URL for ingest or watch actions
